notes: Known-ordering checks for embedding profiles via POST /v1/embeddings (llama-server must run with --embeddings). PASS requires cos(anchor, positive) > cos(anchor, negative) + margin AND a byte-stable (|delta| <= 1e-5) repeated embedding of the anchor. No catalog profile serves embeddings as of 3.1.0; this suite is exercised by tests/test_validation_suites.sh against a fixture server only.

cases.anchor: a cat is sleeping on the sofa
cases.positive: a kitten naps on the couch

cases.anchor: python function that sorts a list
cases.negative: recipe for chocolate cake with butter
